uncertainties.reason: The document provides rate tiers by credit rating but does not define the underwriting criteria for assigning A, B, C, D, or E, except that trucking is A/B credits only.
uncertainties.suggestion: Obtain Falcon's credit-rating matrix or add a catalog field for lender credit grade if grades are assigned outside the engine.

uncertainties.reason: There is no catalog field for lender credit rating. I modeled C, D, and E programs as not available for trucking and modeled the explicit trucking requirements as hard lender-level rules.
uncertainties.suggestion: Confirm whether logging is also subject to A/B-only treatment or only trucking.

uncertainties.reason: 'Commercial related Transactions' is not defined and no catalog field directly identifies commercial vs manufacturing/trucking/logging transactions. I recorded a general soft loan_amount ceiling without an applies_when selector.
uncertainties.suggestion: Define which industries/equipment categories count as commercial transactions for this document.

uncertainties.reason: The document names 'Manufacturing related Transactions (Machine Tools, Woodworking)'. The catalog has equipment_category options for machine_tools and woodworking; I used those rather than industry=manufacturing because the parenthetical identifies equipment types.
uncertainties.suggestion: Confirm whether all manufacturing industry deals, or only machine tools/woodworking equipment, qualify for the $350,000 app-only limit.

uncertainties.reason: The catalog supports years_since_bankruptcy_discharge but not bankruptcy dismissal date. The rule was modeled using discharge seasoning only.
uncertainties.suggestion: Add a field for years_since_bankruptcy_dismissal or use manual review for dismissed bankruptcies.

uncertainties.reason: The guideline says '3+ Years in business—references verified', but the catalog has no field for verified references.
uncertainties.suggestion: Track verified references as a documentation/checklist item outside automated policy rules.

uncertainties.reason: The phrase could mean prior comparable credit originally financed/paid down to at least 70% of the requested amount. I mapped it to comparable_credit_pct >= 70 based on the available field.

uncertainties.item: App-only increase for customers with 12+ months current clean payment history
uncertainties.reason: The phrase implies an existing customer/current finance relationship, but the catalog only has clean_payment_history_months and no current-customer flag. I modeled only the 12-month clean payment condition.
uncertainties.suggestion: Add a current_customer or existing_falcon_customer field if required.

uncertainties.item: Class 8 trucks and trailers age rule
uncertainties.reason: The wording says 'Class 8 trucks and trailers need to be 10 years and newer'. I mapped this to equipment_category in class_8_truck and trailer, while reefer trailers have a separate stricter rule.
uncertainties.suggestion: Confirm whether the 10-year rule applies to all non-reefer trailers or only trailers paired with Class 8 tractors.

uncertainties.reason: Rates, buy-rate adjustments, call-for-rates under $14,999, and soft-collateral market pricing are pricing/display items rather than credit rules per extraction instructions.
uncertainties.suggestion: Store these in pricing configuration if the underwriting engine does not use program details.
